questions.prompt: What showed that Bouncy cared after bumping Fancy?
choices: He apologised and checked on her.
questions.answer: He apologised and checked on her.
questions.rationale: Bouncy saying I am sorry shows that he apologised, and stopping to check on Fancy shows that he checked on her.
questions.evidenceText: "I am sorry," said Bouncy. He stopped to check that she was all right.

questions.prompt: What did Bouncy and Wiggly do with the spilled berries?
choices: They left them on the ground.
They rolled them into the water.
questions.evidenceText: A basket of berries tipped over. They picked them up together.

questions.prompt: How did Bouncy solve his bumping problem?
choices: He stopped moving for the whole day.
He went to the wide empty meadow and watched where he landed.
He asked friends to move out of his way.
questions.answer: He went to the wide empty meadow and watched where he landed.
questions.evidenceText: He went to the wide empty meadow and watched where he landed.
